translations.web: The wild donkeys stand on the bare heights. They pant for air like jackals. Their eyes fail, because there is no vegetation.
translations.bsb: Wild donkeys stand on barren heights; they pant for air like jackals; their eyes fail for lack of pasture.”
translations.kjv: And the wild asses did stand in the high places, they snuffed up the wind like dragons; their eyes did fail, because there was no grass.
translations.asv: And the wild asses stand on the bare heights, they pant for air like jackals; their eyes fail, because there is no herbage.
